title: Placing and mixing
subtitle: Up to 8 pieces in one space
text:
A piece goes into the half or quarter of the space nearest where you click. Vertical slabs sit flat against the face you click, or face you when placed on a top or bottom face. You can keep adding pieces to a space as long as those cells are free.

Every cell remembers its own source block, so one space can mix stone, glass, wood and anything else that can be cut.

steps.text: Each piece keeps its source's colour, light and look. Grass, leaves and other tinted blocks follow the biome. A grass block cut into lower pieces still shows its green side strip.
Faces between two opaque pieces are hidden. Glass next to the same glass hides the shared face, including across neighbouring spaces.
Pieces cut from glowing blocks still give off light. Opaque pieces block light on their faces the way the full block would.
